parameters.query:
SELECT
  alert_id,
  incident_id,
  source,
  alert_type,
  severity,
  payload,
  created_at,
  threat_category,
  priority,
  risk_score,
  ai_recommendation,
  ai_analysis,
  status
FROM alerts
ORDER BY created_at DESC;
